age.evidence: approximately 200-220g upon arrival and 280-320g prior to behavioral testing or electrode implantation

dosing.evidence: 25C-NBOMe (0.03-1.0 mg/kg) was dissolved in saline... All drugs were injected intraperitoneally (i.p.) at a volume of 1 mL/kg.

group_housing.evidence: Rats were group-housed and allowed to acclimate to their new environment for 1 week at least before any experimental procedures were performed.

day_night_flipped.evidence: Rats were housed in a temperature- and humidity-controlled environment with a reversed light-dark cycle (12 vs. 12 hr).

assays.assay_description: Locomotor activity recorded in a square open field chamber (40x40x40 cm, black matte acrylic) for 60 min immediately after i.p. injection, with 3 days of prior habituation.

application_type.evidence: All drugs were injected intraperitoneally (i.p.) at a volume of 1 mL/kg.

setup_habituation.evidence: After habituation for 3 days, rats were placed in open field chambers

setup_restrain.evidence: rats were immediately placed in the open field chambers for 60 min

food_restriction.evidence: Standard OFT; no food in apparatus (not explicitly stated)

water_restriction.evidence: Standard OFT; no water in apparatus (not explicitly stated)

time_to_assay.evidence: After injection with 25C-NBOMe or saline (i.p.), rats were immediately placed in the open field chambers for 60 min.

outcomes.summary: 25C-NBOMe (0.03-1.0 mg/kg, i.p.) significantly affected locomotor activity with an inverted U-shaped dose-response curve, peaking at 5-15 min post-injection.
outcomes.evidence: 25C-NBOMe significantly affect locomotor activity with inverted U-Shaped dose-response curve (Fig. 1A; one-way ANOVA, F (4,35) = 2.404 p = 0.0017).

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: The temporal pattern of locomotor response to 25C-NBOMe. Each point represents the average distance travelled in 5-min bins.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: locomotor activity was recorded through night vision cameras

E1_environment_type.evidence: square open field chamber (40*40*40 CM, made by black matte acrylic)

D1_continuity.evidence: rats were immediately placed in the open field chambers for 60 min

D4_baseline.evidence: Habituation for 3 days but no pre-drug baseline data reported

assays.assay_description: Acoustic startle and prepulse inhibition measured in a sound-attenuated chamber with piezoelectric accelerometric platform; 5-min acclimatization, then pulse-alone, prepulse+pulse (70/75/80 dB prepulse), and no-stimulus trials.

setup_habituation.evidence: Only a 5-min acclimatization within the test session; no separate pre-test habituation described

setup_restrain.evidence: PPI startle chambers; apparatus consisted of one acrylic cage and one piezoelectric accelerometric platform inside of a sound attenuated chamber

food_restriction.evidence: Standard PPI; no food in chamber

water_restriction.evidence: Standard PPI; no water in chamber

time_to_assay.evidence: Time between injection and PPI testing not explicitly stated

sample_size.evidence: N in parentheses corresponds the number of rats per group (specific n not extractable from text)

outcomes.summary: 25C-NBOMe (0.1 mg/kg) significantly attenuated PPI at 75 and 80 dB prepulse intensities without affecting startle response in the pulse-alone trials.
outcomes.statistics: Two-way ANOVA: factor of dosage F(2,40)=7.836, p=0.0013; factor of prepulse intensity F(1.639,65.54)=43.56, p<0.0001; interaction F(4,80)=1.967, p=0.1075
outcomes.evidence: 25C-NBOMe (0.1 mg/kg) significantly attenuated PPI at 75 or 80 dB without affecting startle response.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Startle amplitude (pulse alone) and PPI (% inhibition) at multiple prepulse intensities

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Single averaged values per trial type

B4_ethological.evidence: PPI startle magnitude is not an ethological measure

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Laboratory Animal Behavioral Analysis System (piezoelectric amplitude readout)

E1_environment_type.evidence: acrylic cage and one piezoelectric accelerometric platform inside of a sound attenuated chamber

D1_continuity.evidence: Single test session with acclimatization plus trial block

D2_session_duration.evidence: 5 min acclimatization + 5 pulse-alone stimuli + 5 trial types x 10 reps with 25-35 s ITI (~25-30 min total)

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug PPI baseline data reported

judge_notes: Excluded all electrophysiology/LFP recording analyses (PSD, coherence, time-frequency spectrograms in PrL/OFC/ACC/CA1) per rubric — these are neural recordings, not behavioural assays, even though MDL100,907/haloperidol pretreatment experiments are presented in the same paper.
Retained two behavioural assays: Open Field locomotor activity and Prepulse Inhibition. Both candidates agreed on these.
B1 for OFT scored 0 (single measure: distance travelled). Candidate 'glm' scored 1 but the rubric awards 0 points for 1 measure.
Setup_restrain for PPI scored 'yes' per rubric explicit note that 'PPI startle chambers with body-restraint tubes' count as restraint.
Sample size for PPI left null because exact n's are inside figure parentheses not visible in extracted text.
Day_night_flipped scored 'yes' based on explicit 'reversed light-dark cycle' statement.
